ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 0.15:1 ratio of high-intensity pixels (white scars and water splash) to low-intensity pixels (dark fluke surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark contiguous area covering the majority of the fluke lobes; localized high-contrast white circular ring formations scattered across both lobes; high-intensity white irregular band at the inferior margin obscured by water.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression; wide base with an interior angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration along the entire visible trailing edge; peaks exhibit varied pixel-amplitudes between 5 and 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves extending from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct white ring-shaped pixel clusters (approximately 18 identified) distributed across the dark field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular ring-like markings and a jagged, highly serrated trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Notably high concentration of well-defined white circular ring patterns against a dark background.
